description: This file implements the DataElementFile class, which manages memory-mapped file operations including opening, resizing, and synchronization across different platforms (Windows and POSIX). It handles file mapping, cache updates, and resource cleanup.

classes.name: DataElementFile
classes.description: A class that manages file data through memory mapping, supporting platform-specific implementations for Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.name: DataElementFile::OpenMemoryMappedFile
methods.description: Opens and maps a file into memory with the specified size, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: DataElementFile::~DataElementFile
methods.description: Destructor that unmaps and closes the memory-mapped file handle.

methods.name: DataElementFile::Reallocation
methods.description: Reallocates the memory-mapped file to a new size, handling remapping or re-creation as needed.

methods.name: DataElementFile::Sync
methods.description: Synchronizes the memory-mapped file with the underlying storage, platform-specific.
